movelist.name: Endure
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a damaging Move, you may use Endure as a Free Action. If the Move would bring Endure’s user down to 0 Hit Points or less, Endure’s user instead is set to 1 Hit Point.

movelist.name: Bulk Up
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Focus Energy
movelist.effect: The user becomes Pumped. While Pumped, the user’s Critical Range is extended by 2, or 18+ if the Critical Range is not otherwise extended. Being switched will cause this effect to end.

movelist.name: Rock Smash
movelist.effect: Rock Smash lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Protect
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a Move, the user may use Protect. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move’s effects.

abilities.name: Teamwork
abilities.effect: While you are adjacent to an opponent, allies using Melee attacks against that opponent receive a +2 bonus to Accuracy Checks.

abilities.name: Defiant
abilities.effect: Whenever the user has its Combat Stages lowered, by something other than its own Moves or Abilities, the user’s Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages.
